duration.text: The Electromagnetic Fields and Wireless Technology at Guilin University of Electronic Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Applicant should be between 18 and 40 2. Be in good health condition 3. Two recommendation letters from persons with professional title of associate professor or above
